facts.label: Faculdade comunitária
facts.sub: As faculdades comunitárias têm cursos de dois anos, aulas de inglês e cursos curtos para adultos. Costumam ser mais baratas e têm turmas à noite, para quem trabalha durante o dia.

pages.title: Sign up for a course · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a hot morning in Phoenix. Hugo wants to learn better English for his work. He walks across the campus of a community college. Students sit on the grass with books and coffee. Inside the office, a counselor named Grace smiles at him. A sign on the wall says that a new semester starts soon.
“Good morning! How can I help you?” says Grace. “Hello! I’m here for the course registration.” says Hugo. “Welcome. Please sit down. Which course do you want?” says Grace.
